comments.text: Draft a suitable clause for a will. I have a wife, W and two children, S and D. D is my daughter and currently a minor. I want to create a will that will divide my assets - say A, B and C depending on the circumstances, as under:
a) If  I am survived by my wife, W, all my assets - A, B and C will belong to my wife
b) If I am not survived by my wife and both my kids are adults - assets A and B go to my son, S and my daughter, D gets C.
c) If I am not survived by my wife and my daughter is a minor, assets A, B and C go to my son.
d) If I am not survived by my wife and my son, S, all my assets go to my daughter, D.
e) If I am not survived by anyone of my wife and children,   my assets go to a trust, T.
